claims: The 2026 NFL Draft will be held from April 23–25, 2026.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be held in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
Round 1 of the 2026 NFL Draft is on Thursday, April 23, 8 p.m. ET.
Rounds 2-3 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on Friday, April 24, 7 p.m. ET.
Rounds 4-7 of the 2026 NFL Draft are on Saturday, April 25, Noon ET.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be broadcast on NFL Network.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be broadcast on ESPN2.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be broadcast on ABC.
The 2026 NFL Draft will be broadcast on ESPN Deportes.
